groups.name: guarded compiler agrees with exhaustive synthesis
groups.domain: Every pair of total binary immutable query tables on n=1,2,3,4 states, horizon ceil(log2 n), both proposal rules.

groups.name: scope failures cannot authorize a shortcut
groups.domain: Each of 24 query entries of the n=4, q=6 model changed to a destructive transition, nonbinary report, or inadmissible action; horizon 2.

groups.name: binary family bounds and charged model reads
groups.domain: n=2,4,8,16,32,64 with n+log2(n) queries, all initial states; parent comparison executed only through n=16.

groups.name: fresh relabelings and report flips
groups.domain: All 32 affine permutations modulo 8, eight patterned binary report flips, reversed operation order; 256 cold-start compilations.

groups.name: frozen finite method selector
groups.domain: Rules none/first/balanced selected by total table reads on n=4 and n=8; tested unchanged on cold n=16.

groups.name: common hard allowance and incomplete search semantics
groups.domain: Cold n=16, common table-read cap 2000, and caps 0,1,1727,1728 for the shortcut.

groups.name: fallback can cost more than the incumbent
groups.domain: Equality-only n=4, horizon 3; binary family n=4 with equality-first candidate; non-power-of-two support of six cells.

groups.name: unknown sensor orientation and informative calibration
groups.domain: Two fixed orientation models, both hidden physical states, horizons 0 through 5, reference cost 2 and sense cost 1.

groups.name: tagged model immutability and model-specific domains
groups.domain: Every pair of partial deterministic binary state/report tables on two states for one experiment, including all valid origins and transitions.

groups.name: sequential evidence has nonpositive null drift
groups.domain: All probability triples with denominator 4 on scores -1,0,1; gamma=0,1/3,1/2; four permitted rational bet fractions.

groups.name: anytime threshold across exact null paths
groups.domain: All binary histories through length 10, null means gamma=0,1/3,1/2, thresholds delta=1/2,1/4,1/8, two predictable bet rules.

groups.name: outcome-dependent bets are an invalid audit
groups.domain: Four fair binary observations; choosing bet after the current score yields crossing probability 11/16 at threshold 4.

groups.name: typed evidence update rejects invalid parameters
groups.domain: Negative capital; out-of-range score, gamma or bet; boundary zero capital and maximal permitted bet.

groups.name: equal-quantum racing bound
groups.domain: Abstract resumable worker completion times 1 through 40 in either slot, plus a nonterminating competitor; dispatch overhead 0,1,2.

groups.name: every table row can be decisive for a universal scope audit
groups.domain: All 24 entries of n=4,q=6 changed in turn to report 2; an auditor skipping that entry cannot distinguish the histories.

groups.name: certificate mutation does not create a valid shortcut
groups.domain: Wrong repair, absent report branch, duplicate branch, insufficient depth and insufficient storage on n=8.

arithmetic: Exact integers and fractions.Fraction; no random samples.
non_claims: Not a proof assistant or external replication.
Measured compiler reads are not total CPU cost.
No neural training, learned physical model, or open-ended self-rewriting.
The fair-racing checks concern abstract worker schedules, not a resumable version of the shipped compiler.
